caption: The drawing depicts a geometric quilt pattern composed of interlocking shapes, mainly diamonds and hexagons, arranged into a star motif. The central section features alternating clusters of three blue diamonds and three beige diamonds with floral prints, forming a three-dimensional cube effect. Surrounding this central area are four large red triangular shapes, each constructed from three smaller triangles, also with stitched and shaded detail. The outer edges of the pattern display cubes in varying shades and patterns, including brown solid, gray, light gray, checkered red and white, striped beige, and different gray and white textile prints. The quilt pattern is set on a plain, uncolored background. The artist's signature, "Elizabeth W. Garrison," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
